posts.title: Training a Chess Reasoning Agent
posts.description: TLDR: I trained an LLM reasoning agent to play chess, with model sizes 0.8B, 2B and 9B. The agent calls tools which help it keep track of the board state, which enables good performance with a relatively small number of parameters. The demo code is available on Github .
